iti22:2.2: sukhass-etaṃ bhikkhave adhivacanaṃ, iṭṭhassa kantassa piyassa manāpassa, yad-idaṃ puññāni.
iti22:2.3: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ dīgharattaṃ iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vipākaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ.
iti22:2.4: Satta vassāni mettacittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na-yimaṃ lokaṃ punar-āgamāsi,
iti22:2.5: saṃvaṭṭamāne sudaṃ bhikkhave kappe ābhassarūpago homi,
iti22:3.1: Tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā homi mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī.
iti22:3.2: Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave sakko ahosiṃ devānam-indo,
iti22:3.3: anekasatakkhattuṃ rājā ahosiṃ, cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
iti22:4.2: Kissa nu kho me idaṃ kammassa phalaṃ, kissa kammassa vipāko, yenāhaṃ etarahi evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo ti?
iti22:4.4: Tiṇṇaṃ kho me idaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko, yenāhaṃ etarahi evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo ti, seyyathīdaṃ
iti22:7.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||2|| 23. (Ek.
